- 08:30–09:15 PT: Systems design (Marcus lead)
- 09:15–09:30 PT: 15-min overlap / buffer for handoff (Marcus + Mina)

Laura — thanks for the layout. A couple of operational tweaks from the eng side:

- Move pair-programming to immediately after Systems design (09:15–10:00) while technical context is freshest.
- Make PM product session at 10:00–10:45 to avoid cognitive load stacking.
- Keep a 15-min overlap between Systems and Pair-program so the primary interviewer can hand artifacts to the pair-programmer.

Why: pair-programming requires state (problem prompt / starter code) and it’s easier to hand that between two engineers than from systems->PM. Also would prefer a 10-min micro-break before behavioral panel so Alex can reset.

I’ll be Systems lead (08:30). Mina — can you confirm you’re comfortable being shadow on systems then leading PM?

Thanks,
